title: Construct all-direction velocity variance with small self-advection in six rational channels
statement: Let M=R^6,N=2M+1,D_M(theta)=N^-1 sum_{j=-M}^M exp(2pi i j theta),J_M=D_M^32. Set v1=J(y)[J(z)-J(z-1/2)],v2=[J(x)-J(x-1/2)]J(z-1/4),v3=[J(x-1/4)-J(x-3/4)]J(y-1/4). Each component is independent of its own coordinate, so v is divergence-free with zero mean. Quarter shifts give rational real trig coefficients. The source proves ||v||infinity<=2,||grad v||<=10^4M,||Delta v||<=10^6M^2,||(v dot grad)v||<=10^12 M^-30 and integral(e dot v)^2>=10^-12 M^-2 for every unit e. Orthogonal channel pairs supply variance while separated transverse kernels suppress cross-advection.
